mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, the skies are mainly clear over Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 71 degrees. The moon is a waning crescent, and we expect an overnight low of 66 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City news this week focuses on infrastructure, with the latest engineering reports now available for public viewing through the city website. Additionally, remember to check out the tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center if you are looking to enjoy a ride along the Military Ridge State Trail.

We have a busy schedule today with live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus a free girls try hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow and trivia at various local spots early next week.
In our weekly police report, on July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that resulted in a driver being arrested for an O W I and cited for suspended registration.
Today's featured flavor is the Snickers Swirl. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10:00 AM tomorrow morning, when the flavor will be Georgia Peach.
